newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares finish firm but off day's highs.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares finish firm but off day's highs.

text.p: 1540 GMT -- Dutch shares finish firm, but off day's highs after relief over U.S. election result boosts markets. Dealers say Clinton reelection with Republicans retaining control of Congress ideal. Hagemeyer finishes strongly after says to buy rest of Hong Kong joint venture. Akzo-Nobel, Unilever and KLM all lose ground. Ahold closes just off year high at 104.90.
* AEX ends up 3.40 points, or 0.58 pct, at 589.43.

* Hagemeyer up 4.20 guilders to 134.20, Ahold up 1.40 guilders. KLM loses 2.10 to 41.70. Akzo down 2.30 to 215.30 after flat results. Unilever loses 2.50 guilders after analysts trim earnings estimates ahead of results Friday.
